label: War
description: A war, a campaign, a battle or a siege: organised armed force between polities.

label: Treaty
description: An agreement between polities: a treaty, a pact, an accession, a concordat.

label: Election
description: A vote that fills an office or a chamber, and the leadership contests that decide who stands in one.

label: Revolution
description: A seizure or a loss of power outside the ordinary rules: a revolution, a coup, an uprising, a mutiny.

label: Law
description: A constitution, a statute, a decree or a court ruling: the state changing what the rules are.

label: Founding
description: Something coming into existence or ending: a state, an institution, a party, a company.

label: Disaster
description: Harm from something nobody chose: an earthquake, a flood, a fire, an epidemic, a wreck.

label: Economy
description: Money and what it does: a crisis, a bailout, a nationalisation, a currency, a trade agreement.

label: Culture
description: A work, a movement, a building, an exhibition, a broadcast, a sporting occasion.

label: Science
description: A discovery, an expedition, a technology or a piece of engineering.

label: Death
description: A person's death, whether by illness, accident, execution or assassination.

label: Other
description: None of the above. A category the atlas has too few of to name yet, never a category nobody looked for.
